| BizLine                       | String  | Trading type / business line         |
| Volume                        | String  | Trading volume                       |
| TotalCommission               | String  | Total commission                     |
| BrokerCommission              | String  | Broker’s commission                  |

| SpotTradingVolumeWithTag      | String  | Spot trading volume (with tag)       |
| FutureTradingVolumeWithTag    | String  | Futures trading volume (with tag)    |
| TradingFeeWithTag             | String  | Trading fee (with tag)               |
| CommissionWithTag             | String  | Contributed commission (with tag)    |

name: Set Markup Fee
description:
When setting the mark-up fee, both the Maker mark-up fee and the Taker mark-up fee must be set together. It is not permitted to set only the Maker mark-up fee or only the Taker mark-up fee.
Setting both the Maker mark-up fee and the Taker mark-up fee to 0 will cancel the mark-up fee. For example, this applies to canceling the default mark-up fee or canceling the mark-up fee for a specified UID.
The numerical requirements for the Maker mark-up fee and the Taker mark-up fee are as follows:
- For spot trading: Taker markup fee ≥ Maker markup fee
- For futures trading: Maker markup fee − Taker markup fee ≤ 0.025%
- Absolute value of mark‑up for Taker orders – range: [0, 0.03] for spot, [0, 0.001] for futures. Maker and Taker must be set together.
- Absolute value of mark‑up for Taker orders – range: [0, 0.03] for spot, [0, 0.001] for futures. Maker and Taker must be set together."

subUids.description: Valid when effectiveType=UID_SPECIFIC; specify the sub‑account UIDs to be set (up to 20). Ignored when effectiveType=DEFAULT.

effectAt.description: Effective timestamp for the mark‑up fee (in milliseconds). If not provided, it defaults to 00:10 at the earliest UTC+8 T+1 (the next calendar day)."

makerMarkUp.description: Absolute value of mark‑up for Taker orders – range: [0, 0.03] for spot, [0, 0.001] for futures. Maker and Taker must be set together.

takerMarkUp.description: Absolute value of mark‑up for Taker orders – range: [0, 0.03] for spot, [0, 0.001] for futures. Maker and Taker must be set together."

customApiFields.17: Set broker mark-up fee

name: Add Order
description:
:::info[Description]
Place order to the futures trading system, you can place two major types of orders: limit and market. Orders can only be placed if your account has sufficient funds. Once an order is placed, your funds will be put on hold for the duration of the order. The amount of funds on hold depends on the order type and parameters specified.
:::

:::tip[Tips]
The maximum limit orders for a single contract is 100 per account, and the maximum stop orders for a single contract is 200 per account.
:::

clientOid.description: Unique order id created by users to identify their orders, the maximum length cannot exceed 40, e.g. UUID, Only allows numbers, characters, underline(_), and separator(-)

side.description: specify if the order is to 'buy' or 'sell'

symbol.description: Symbol of the contract, Please refer to [Get Symbol endpoint: symbol](/docs-new/rest/futures-trading/market-data/get-all-symbols)

leverage.description: Used to calculate the margin to be frozen for the order. If you are to close the position, this parameter is not required.

type.description: specify if the order is an 'limit' order or 'market' order

stop.description: Either 'down' or 'up'.  If stop is used,parameter stopPrice and stopPriceType also need to be provieded.

x-apidog-enum.name: down
x-apidog-enum.description: Triggers when the price reaches or goes below the stopPrice.

x-apidog-enum.name: up
x-apidog-enum.description: Triggers when the price reaches or goes above the stopPrice

stopPriceType.description: Either 'TP' or 'MP', Need to be defined if stop is specified.

x-apidog-enum.name: trade price
x-apidog-enum.description: TP for trade price, The last trade price is the last price at which an order was filled. This price can be found in the latest match message.

x-apidog-enum.name: mark price
x-apidog-enum.description: MP for mark price, The mark price can be obtained through relevant OPEN API for index services

stopPrice.description: Need to be defined if stop is specified.

reduceOnly.description: A mark to reduce the position size only. Set to false by default. Need to set the position size when reduceOnly is true. If set to true, only the orders reducing the position size will be executed. If the reduce-only order size exceeds the position size, the extra size will be canceled.

closeOrder.description: A mark to close the position. Set to false by default. If closeOrder is set to true, the system will close the position and the position size will become 0. Side, Size and Leverage fields can be left empty and the system will determine the side and size automatically.

marginMode.description: Margin mode: ISOLATED, CROSS default: ISOLATED.

price.description: Required for type is 'limit' order, indicating the operating price

size.description: Order size (Lot), must be a positive integer. The quantity unit of coin-swap contracts is size(lot), and other units are not supported.

timeInForce.description: Optional for type is 'limit' order, [Time in force](/docs-new/enums-definitions) is a special strategy used during trading, default is GTC

x-apidog-enum.name: Good Till Canceled
x-apidog-enum.description: order remains open on the order book until canceled. This is the default type if the field is left empty.

x-apidog-enum.name: Immediate Or Cancel
x-apidog-enum.description: being matched or not, the remaining size of the order will be instantly canceled instead of entering the order book.

postOnly.description: Optional for type is 'limit' order,  post only flag, invalid when timeInForce is IOC. The post-only flag ensures that the trader always pays the maker fee and provides liquidity to the order book. If any part of the order is going to pay taker fee, the order will be fully rejected.

positionSide.description: Position direction, optional in one-way mode, defaults to BOTH. Required in hedge mode.

x-apidog-enum.name: long
x-apidog-enum.description: LONG for long position in hedge mode.

x-apidog-enum.name: short
x-apidog-enum.description: SHORT for short position in hedge mode.

customApiFields.17: Place order to the futures trading system, you can place two major types of orders: limit and market. Orders can only be placed if your account has sufficient funds. Once an order is placed, your funds will be put on hold for the duration of the order. The amount of funds on hold depends on the order type and parameters specified.

name: Add Take Profit And Stop Loss Order
description:
:::info[Description]
Place take profit and stop loss order supports both take-profit and stop-loss functions, and other functions are exactly the same as the place order interface.

You can place two types of orders: Limit and market. Orders can only be placed if your account has sufficient funds. Once an order is placed, your funds will be put on hold for the duration of the order. The amount of funds on hold depends on the order type and parameters specified.

Please note that the system will hold the fees from the orders entered in the orderbook in advance. 
:::

name: Cancel Order By OrderId
description:
:::info[Description]
Cancel an order (including a stop order).

You will receive a success message once the system has received the cancellation request. The cancellation request will be processed by matching engine in sequence. To know if the request has been processed, you may check the order status or update message from the Websocket pushes.

The ‘orderId’ is the server-assigned order ID, not the specified clientOid.

If the order can not be canceled (already filled or previously canceled, etc.), then an error response will indicate the reason in the message field.
:::

customApiFields.17: Cancel order by system-generated orderId.

If the order can not be canceled (already filled or previously canceled, etc.), then an error response will indicate the reason in the message field.
